summary: Corporacion America Airports S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on May 13, 2026. Shareholders approved the presentation and approval of financial statements, allocation of profits (USD 5.2M to legal reserve, USD 98.8M carried forward), granted discharge to directors, and re-appointed six board members for a term until 2029. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing reflects ordinary corporate governance and is not a trigger for analysis under special-situations categorization.
